Passengers and crew in Lifeboat B experience intense fear and distress.

The passengers who enter the water suffer hypothermia.
Lifeboat B becomes more stable in the storm.
The remaining people in Lifeboat B face a lower immediate risk of sinking.
Survivors in both lifeboats experience shock, grief, and trauma.
